Dialogs.Dialog: Oh right. What type of girl do you like？
My type？ Hmm, in a word...
I kind of like smart, strong-willed types.
Smart, and says what she thinks？
And sometimes bullies you a bit？
Huh, I see, so I'm allowed to bully you.
The kind and outgoing type, I guess？
The type who'd even go along with your selfish requests？
Then, I guess that means someone older？
I see. Maybe I don't need to worry so much...
Someone like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is now, I guess？
Ah... yeah, I see. Got it. Thanks.
...Sorry, that was a little embarrassing even for me.
Hehe... I'm a little embarrassed too... maybe？
By the way, what type of girl do you really like？
Kind and gentle, I guess？ Someone too loud is a bit much.
Hmm, then maybe I was fine the way I was before...
Someone like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is now is my type, I guess...
Someone who's straightforward and lets her feelings out, you know.
Even if I bully you sometimes？
Hmm, I see... yeah, thanks for answering.
Come to think of it... what's your type？
I like girls who are kind and gentle, I guess？
Nothing. I just thought you're surprisingly the type who wants to take the lead.
Hehe. Kind and gentle, right？ Wouldn't you end up leading？
I see, so that kind is fine.
The way ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is now is ideal, I guess.
It's not flattery. Kind and accepting, I really like people like that.
It was a little embarrassing to say, though.
Hehe. You were cute, blushing like that, you know？
What's the matter？ Did something happen？
No, it's not that. The movie...
The movie I just saw moved me so much... remembering it made me cry again.
I see. Is ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ the type to get emotionally invested in characters？
Not usually... this one was special, I guess.
But crying just from remembering it, it must've been a really good movie.
What kind of movie is it？
A pure love story. About a female teacher who falls in love with her student.
I see, so you got invested in the teacher.
Ah, I'll get going. With my face like this. Bye.
(...All right, the floor's calmed down. Break time.)
Okay, Nene-chan, you're cute！ With this, he'll be head over heels, right!?
Well, sort of. What were you doing？
Um, well... right！ Checking my appearance. Uniform, hair, stuff like that.
Ah, it's a customer service job, after all.
But there was something about head over heels...
That's... you know, we have to make the customers fall head over heels for us！
All right, time to work hard again today！
Um, I have a little favor to ask？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ asking me？ That's rare. What is it？
The manager originally asked me, but...
Sure. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is handling lots of other stuff anyway.
Thanks. You really have become dependable.
Ah, you think？ I'm a full-fledged worker now.
In that case, maybe I'll ask you for all sorts of other things too.
This, and that... it'll be so nice to take it easy.
Hehe, kidding. But you've been working hard lately, so maybe I'll give you a reward.
...Did you think of something weird？ No reward for a kid like that.
No, it's nothing. The coffee was just hot.
I can't handle hot drinks. Sorry for startling you.
Huh, that's unexpected. From perfect ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Just because I can't take hot things, that's...
Saying stuff like that, you're not cute.
I have to get some payback once in a while.
The other day, you ate the pizza from your own wrong order without asking, didn't you.
And you haven't washed that uniform since last week, right？ The manager will be mad if he finds out, you know？
Um... I'm going back to work！
Same. Ah... spotted a button that's about to fall off.
You're right. Oh well, I'll just pull it off.
Something like this, I'd sew it on if you just asked.
Thanks. So ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is good at sewing too.
Not really. I'm a girl, so it's normal.
What？ Did you want me to stay close longer？
Well then, big sis has to get going. Be careful, okay？
Keep your head up. I'll pinch your nose for you.
It's fine. I'll just stuff some tissue up my nose...
Nope, then you'll hurt it again when you pull it out.
Never mind, just be good for a bit, okay？
(It hurt, but I got a little lucky.)
Ugh, missed. Sorry, I'll go get it！
You're welcome. So this club practices boys and girls together？
Our club's pretty loose about that.
Hmm. Still, she's a really pretty girl...
So a girl like that is your teammate...
No, nothing. See you, good luck.
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was here too？ I didn't notice.
Well, a friend from the tennis club was over there, so I was going to call out to her.
Right then ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ called me, so I was surprised.
I see, I got in the way.
In the way？ It's not like I had anything to talk to her about.
No, I'll get going. You go to her.
(She really left. She didn't need to worry about it.)
(Once I finish cleaning here, next is around back...)
Not at all, this is a piece of cake.
I see. I don't want to get in the way of your work, so I'll go.
All right, I guess that'll do here.
Cleaning here. It's not clean at all, so do it over.
Come on, I did it properly.
Isn't it fine？ Something like this is a piece of cake for you, right？
Ow, ow, I did it now.
I'll go get disinfectant and a bandage.
You got hurt？ I'll patch you up.
It's fine, a friend from the tennis club is going to do it.
I said it's fine. It'd be bad to make someone outside the club do it.
Geez. Then have that girl do it！
(Did I say something to make her mad？)
▲主人公＊▲. When you finish sorting there, take the front desk next.
All right, let's finish this quick.
Yeah, borrowing a book. ...That girl just now is cute.
You think？ She's a year below me, but she's my senior on the committee, so she teaches me the work.
Ugh, geez, I can never finish these checkout records！
That's what you get for always letting your work pile up.
Shut up. More importantly, help me.
You're not going to help her？
She brought it on herself, so it's fine. Spoiling her won't do her any good either.
Well, sure, she's on the same committee.
▲小早川＊▲, what are you up to？
Does it matter？ What are you, my dad？
Like I said, what are you, my dad？
Geez, if I nag too much, she'll really end up hating me.
Maybe nobody likes getting nagged by someone older.
Yeah. Do you think I'm annoying too？
Could it be you came to see me？
You know, I keep working here because you're here.
Geez, you fall for things way too easily.
Not that it's all a lie, though.
Today's your last day working at Dixie's too, huh.
Having you here was a big help in lots of ways.
Of course. And work got more fun than before.
Really？ It was fun for me too.
Hehe. From now on, I'll be a customer, I guess？
Well, see you. It was like having a little brother, and I was happy.
(She really was like a big sister...)
Yeah, right. I wish I could've worked up the courage before I graduated.
Playing the big sister forever like this is too painful...
I wanted to graduate from being your big sister too...
